tasks.title: T20-US-001: DNA-to-culture ancestry mapper
tasks.description:
As a user, I want to upload my DNA results and see associated cultures, languages, and cuisines so I can explore my heritage — processed privately.

Acceptance criteria (all must be met before marking complete):
- Add a client-side 23andMe/AncestryDNA file parser (all processing in-browser; nothing uploaded/stored)
- Map extracted haplogroups to cultures/languages via HaplogroupFeature.associatedLanguageFamilyIds/associatedCivilizationIds and server/services/genetic-linguistic-correlation.ts
- Render a 'your ancestors likely spoke / ate / lived among…' view with confidence and clear caveats
- vitest tests cover the parser + mapping on synthetic fixtures; `npm run check` passes
